description: This PHP file defines an abstract class 'CodeRenderer' responsible for rendering code blocks in Markdown with Confluence-specific HTML structures. It includes methods for escaping CDATA sections and generating HTML elements for code snippets with optional language parameters.

classes.name: CodeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class implementing NodeRendererInterface for rendering code blocks with Confluence-specific HTML formatting.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Escapes CDATA end sequence within content to prevent XML parsing errors.

methods.name: getHTMLElement
methods.description: Generates a structured macro HTML element for a code block, including optional language parameter.
